summary.text: There is a /registry/document-index and /registry/document-requests. Let's inspect these directories. They may contain index of available documents.

output.name: bash
output.arguments: {"command":"find /registry -type f -o -type l | sort; echo \"======\"; for f in $(find /registry -type f | sort); do echo \"--- $f\"; cat \"$f\"; echo; done"}
